design_authorization.scope: Design, CPU metadata preparation, implementation and focused checks. The fulfilled response-capture approval does not authorize this training.

source_roles.HOU: Full exposed-development registry; excluded from fitting and threshold selection.
source_roles.DET: Only the18 original historical appearance queries after the final fixed fit. No method/parameter/threshold/checkpoint choice; no new DET frames.
source_roles.split_limit: New-scorer leave-game-out only; cosine nine already trained on all three NBA sources. Not end-to-end unseen-game validation.

target.meaning: Usable candidate-point localization under accepted source-coordinate references, not semantic object identity or calibrated ball probability.
target.positive: Eligible certain reference, in source bounds, Euclidean distance<=10 source pixels.
target.negative: Certain-hidden frame; or eligible point beyond10+recorded placement radius (out-of-bounds also unusable; all19632current points are in bounds).
target.unknown: All masked-frame candidates and eligible misses within10<distance<=10+placement radius.
target.uncertainty: Asymmetric fitting mask only; no soft probabilities or formal confidence bound inferred from radii. Original inclusive10 evaluation unchanged.

model.frozen: Embeddings and first10transformer blocks, evaluation mode, no gradients.
model.input: Original64source-pixel crop; floor-center minus32; blackpadding; Pillowbicubic256 then center224; originalRGB normalization; noaugmentation.
model.point: Original fractional-coordinate bilinear weights at sequenceindices120,121,136,137; float64interpolation then oneL2normalization, castunitvector tofloat32forhead.

training.permutation: Python random.Random(seed+epoch), shuffle each eligible fitting candidate once per epoch.
training.head_initialization: PyTorch Linear defaults after the fixed seed and deterministic backbone construction.
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch6 only; no validation-based selection. Every completed epoch also saves trainable parameters, optimizer and RNG state for later explicit recovery, never epoch selection or automatic resume.

evaluation.boundary_rule: Strictly greater than0 survives, equality is a tie. Missing has noimage score;0is only its comparison reference.
outputs: all original frame records including empty and unknown
all adverse and useful overlapping tags

execution.time_estimate: No local training benchmark. One-hour expenditure limit, not predicted duration; preserve incomplete work if reached.
execution.memory_estimate: Unmeasured GPU peak; frozen-prefix no-grad avoids its activation graph. Disk: nativeuint8 crop caches ~386MB, four final checkpoints ~58MB,24recovery checkpoints withoptimizer/RNG ~1.04GB; about1.5GB plusmetadata/journals.
execution.runtime_producer_check: First training batch perfit reuses its actualpointfeatures; one extra standard backboneforward compares original fullsequence point_readout beforefirstupdate, atol/rtol1e-10. Checkfinite/nonzerohead+backbonegradients; frozenweightsunchanged.
